Quotes.title: Quotes
Quotes.body:
Your quotes with their lifecycle: create, send, accept or decline, revise, convert into an invoice.

Sending mints the number, the document and an accept link; nothing is transmitted locally, you get the link to pass on. A revision becomes a new version while the old one remains.

Nothing ever posts here: even converting only creates an invoice draft.
